integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. a small military vehicle-wash bay of riveted grey steel plates. Wet grey concrete floor, two faded yellow safety lines, one rectangular drain hole at centre with the grate lying face down beside it, red-wheel water valves and a coiled hose reel on the left wall, electric cabinets and a broom on the right wall, two stacked steel drums at rear right, a white canvas curtain on a ceiling rail at the back, a bare chain with a hook above the drain, two caged industrial lamps hanging from the riveted steel ceiling. The bay is fully ENCLOSED: the riveted steel ceiling spans the entire top of frame and solid steel walls close every side - no sky, no clouds, no windows, no daylight openings anywhere; when the camera looks up it sees only the steel ceiling, the caged lamps and the chain. Cool hard overhead light, short shadows, wet surfaces. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. Exactly two clay puppets appear in the frame: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right; no other people or animals appear. AT START: A tall mustached man on the left holds a cream telephone receiver to his ear and raises his empty other hand, while a shorter man in a brown cap and mustard sweater stands empty-handed on the right with a pencil behind his ear; a metal bucket is between them, red-handled pipes and a large valve wheel are on the left wall, a white curtain is behind them, a chain hangs near the center, metal drums are at the far right, caged lights are overhead, and no floor or water is visible.. [Shot 1] Close insert: TEO's military boot taps twice on the wet concrete beside the cream phone box lying face down by the drain; at frame right the black casters of a low drum dolly roll into view. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a wide shot: JUCA pushes the low dolly forward, its front caster climbs onto the fallen phone box, the bakelite case cracks and flattens under the wheel, the dolly tips over on its side, and the empty steel drum rolls off across the bay with the loose steel grate landing flat on top of it; TEO straightens up and points at the hole a beat too late. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a wide shot: the drum rolls to the right wall and stops there with the steel grate balanced on top, the crushed phone box juts out from under the toppled dolly, and JUCA puts both hands on his knees and follows the drum with his head. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: empty steel drum at rest against the right wall with the steel grate balanced flat on top; client gone; phone box crushed under the toppled dolly.
overall_soundscape: A military boot taps twice on wet concrete, then the dolly caster scrapes over the bakelite phone box and the hollow steel drum rolls away with a low rumble. TEO makes one short nasal snort. JUCA clicks his tongue once.
